title: Extend dual list-string parsing across MCP arguments
outcome: List-like MCP string arguments consistently accept comma-separated values and JSON-array encoded strings without changing their host-compatible schemas.
acceptance: Invalid encodings return the established bounded structured domain-error shape.
Kinds, usage kinds, spans, and every other selected list-like string argument normalize CSV and JSON-array encoded strings identically.
Published MCP schemas remain string-based and existing callers retain their behavior.
The capability is represented by its own features[] identifier and BuildInfo.Version is bumped.
